subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Chekhov and the Plotless Story
description: Learn Chekhov and the Plotless Story in one minute.

hook.text: Anton Chekhov revolutionized the short story by proving that nothing dramatic needs to happen for a story to work.

buildup.text: His stories focus on mood, atmosphere, and small moments of human connection or disconnection.

discovery.text: The Lady with the Dog ends without resolution: two people in love with no way forward, just enduring together.

twist.text: Chekhov was also a practicing doctor who said medicine was his wife and literature was his mistress.

climax.text: He taught writers that the power of a story lies not in what happens, but in what is left unsaid.

punchline.text: The master of short fiction mastered the art of silence.

quiz.question: What did Chekhov prove about short stories?
options: They must always have a dramatic twist ending
Nothing dramatic needs to happen for a story to be powerful
They should always be exactly ten pages long
